title.narrative: CURE Foundation: Increasing the resilience of the feminist and LGBTIQ+ community towards the anti-gender movement in Bosnia and Herzegovina

description.narrative: CURE’s project "Increasing the resilience of the feminist and LGBTIQ+ community towards the anti-gender movement in Bosnia and Herzegovina" is the continuation of the project of the same name (Ref: SE-ON-802401-6134-WB-BA1) under the 2024-2025 programme “The Kvinna till Kvinna Regional Programme - Democracy and Resilience in the Western Balkans: Supporting Feminist Change Agents” (Ref: SE-ON-802401-6134-WB).

Within the Kvinnna till Kvinna Foundation's regional programme "Democracy and Resilience in the Western Balkans: Supporting Feminist Change Agents 2.0" the partner organisation CURE Foundation is implementing the project "Increasing the resilience of the feminist and LGBTIQ+ community towards the anti-gender movement in Bosnia and Herzegovina". The project is aimed at increasing the resilience against the anti-democratic movements in Bosnia and Herzegovina. This will be achieved through workshops focus on increasing the knowledge and skills in human rights and integrated security for women’s rights defenders and LGBTIQ+ activists and rights defenders. The workshops will cover a range of issues from digital security, physical security, stress management and legal considerations in order to improve the safety and well-being of the activists. There will also be elements of online campaigns in order to increase the visibility of the women's rights movement in the social and political context.
